title: uxc marketplace listing (marketplace.json)
description: Listing and version metadata sent by uxc mp publish (scaffold: uxc mp init). mp publish refuses a missing slug, summary, category, audience or maintainer; unknown keys are tolerated.

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it.

slug.description: Marketplace id of the addon, lowercase kebab-case (uxc mp install <slug>).

description.description: Long description (defaults to the manifest description).

category.description: Category. The seed vocabulary: content-intelligence, contract-intelligence, invoice-ap, hr-employee, quality-compliance, records-management, case-management, ai-assistants, search-discovery, demo-showcase, utilities, other (the server is the authority).

audience.description: Who may install it. customer-demo and prospect-demo need "account".

account.description: Account the listing is restricted to (required unless audience is generic).

compatibility.description: Versions the addon was tested on (tags).

docs.description: Package-relative documentation files uploaded with the version (must exist).

changelog.description: Release notes of this version (uxc mp publish --notes overrides).
